title: Kirk Cousins: Black Hole fans are dying to cheer for us, we've got to give them a reason

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kirk Cousins: Black Hole fans are dying to cheer for us, we've got to give them a reason
sources.description: Raiders quarterback Kirk Cousins played in front of the home fans in Las Vegas for the first time in Thursday night's preseason opener, and he said afterward that he wants to give that passionate fan base a reason to celebrate.
